race.comment: COLT FORTY FIVE (3) has been freshened up since failing to cope with a testing heavy track at Warrnambool a couple of months ago. He resumes without any public hit-outs but will slide back into a very winnable race. If ready, he is the one to beat. MANCHEGO (6) was an easy last-start winner in similar company a month ago at Echuca, and has been nominated everywhere, so if he lines up here, he should be hard to beat again. ONLOOKER (1) was put aside after winning his maiden at Ballarat last season. He won his latest of 3 jump-outs and will be ready to rumble fresh. Follow any market confidence. RATTLE'N'ROLL (8) resumes from a spell, and will have the advantage of the pole position. He has been tuned-up with 3 jump-outs, and he can't be taken lightly fresh up. Each way. BATTLE OF THE ICE (9) had excuses last time out, and will find this an easier assignment. He benefits from a 3kg claim, and is worth including in all top 4 combos.
